bear_assumptions: USD 8.00 normalized forward EPS at 12.5x as handset contraction, customer concentration, input costs, and licensing pressure reduce earnings and the valuation multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 10.00 normalized forward EPS at 16x as handset revenue stabilizes, automotive and IoT growth continue, pricing partly repairs margins, and net debt limits the valuation multiple.
bull_assumptions: USD 11.00 normalized forward EPS at 20x as non-handset growth accelerates, handset and licensing economics stabilize, and QCT margins recover.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores required expected return, base upside, downside payoff, and margin of safety while handset revenue and QCT margins stabilize; downgrade on persistent handset erosion, weaker licensing economics, continued margin compression, rising inventory, leverage or dilution, adverse trade restrictions, or failed non-handset execution.
